correctness.rationale: The coordinate Gram matrix is I+11ᵀ with determinant 4, so ambient H³ equals twice coordinate volume. On the zero-sum hyperplane the root hull is the positive-mass unit ball: each positive coordinate can be supplied from the negative ones, giving root weights of total mass at most one, with any remainder at the origin. For a point y in the open cube only shifts 0 and −1 can occur in each coordinate. For t=sum(y)<1 only the empty set and singleton shift sets qualify, and reflection gives the t>2 slab. In the middle slab, each singleton {j} qualifies for y_j≥t−1 and its complement qualifies for y_j≤t−1, so there are three shifts off the equality planes. The two extra corner simplices each have volume 1/6, giving C(0)=10/3. For integral k the Fourier coefficient of the periodization is the original coefficient, and reflection makes the corner integrals conjugate. The size-parameter Laplace integral over the simplex yields the four linear factors including the slack factor z. At simple poles the evaluated exponent is one and the coefficient is proportional to (2πi)⁻³, hence purely imaginary. At a double node r the real term is (2πi)⁻²/[(s−r)(t−r)]; two double nodes give two such terms with the same squared denominator; at a triple node the real term is −(2πi)⁻²/(s−r)². Doubling the real parts gives all stated nonzero coefficients, with the correct sign and no further cancellation. Subtracting the ordered triples of distinct nonzero values from (2N+1)³ gives 24N²+2N+1, including N=0.
residual_risks: The periodization identity ignores cube boundaries and equality planes, which do not affect the integrals. Tests are bounded; the cube-count check uses the implemented coefficient formula, not an independent Fourier computation at every frequency.

evidence: For a nonresonant direction the vertex expansion along τk is τ⁻³ times a sum of vertex phases with fixed rational weights. Boundedness at τ→0 forces the sum of these weights to vanish, while τ=1 makes every phase one at integral vertices. The root-hull edge directions are roots, so distinct coordinate phases are nonresonant. This credits the four-distinct vanishing implication to prior general machinery.

The resonant hyperplanes do not come with an automatic nonzero coefficient. The new reduction identifies the surplus over multiplicity three as a pair of opposite simplices and computes their real-part contributions exactly by pole multiplicity.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Once the cuboctahedral multiplicity law is known, ordinary simplex transforms and counting give the table and count; those standard tools neither identify the surplus by themselves nor supply the absence of additional support zeros.

evidence: In these lattice coordinates the root hull is the difference body of the coordinate simplex. Folding/unfolding identifies torus coefficients of its translate multiplicity with the integer-frequency transform. The established lattice multiple-tiling criterion for constant multiplicity would require every nonzero lattice coefficient to vanish; here the multiplicity is nonconstant.

The octahedral analog uses the standard ℓ₁ ball with six vertices, not the twelve-vertex root hull. In the two stated coordinates k=(0,1,2) has an A3 phase collision but has distinct absolute frequencies.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The periodization description is an equivalent lattice-function formulation, not a constant multi-tiling. The arrangement and common box count in the octahedral result do not give an equivalent coefficient formula or polytope.

value.rationale: For the natural A3 root lattice and its root polytope, the exact support equality determines which dual-lattice frequencies survive rather than only where they might survive. The two-corner periodization is independently useful as a complete lattice covering multiplicity calculation and explains the sharp reduction from cubic to quadratic frequency-box growth. The contribution is the exact geometric and arithmetic classification, not just evaluating a few transforms via a general algorithm.
residual_risks: The classification is for this lattice realization without dilation, not arbitrary lattices, affine coordinate changes that change the lattice, or other ranks.
